classification_semantics.VERIFIED_NATIVE_EFFECT: Direct effect-specific evidence is verified for the registered implementation. implementation distinguishes source_native from basilisk_native; this is not hardware or flight validation.
classification_semantics.DELIVERY_ONLY_INCONCLUSIVE: Event delivery is auditable but current outputs do not establish the requested effect.
classification_semantics.PROJECT_PROXY: A project proxy behavior is verified; native physical-equivalence claims are forbidden.
classification_semantics.OUT_OF_SCOPE: The effect is not executable and must be rejected before execution.

The whole-spacecraft graph contains four engineering-proxy power bridges (five when propulsion is enabled); these remain explicit in runtime provenance.
effects.rationale: The official Basilisk reaction-wheel state effector receives the project-native command-path output. Direct recorder fields show zero drive authority and a bounded reverse braking command while the wheel is jammed.

Ignition failure is represented by the project-native one-shot burn controller issuing a zero on-time command to the official Basilisk thruster effector; physical valve, ignition energy and combustion transients are not modeled.
The whole-spacecraft graph includes five engineering-proxy power bridges when propulsion is enabled, including the propulsion activity-to-power bridge.
effects.rationale: The direct burn-command, burn-status, thruster force and fuel-tank recorders show that the scheduled ignition request is suppressed, no thrust is produced and propellant mass is preserved.

effects.rationale: The project-native burn controller recorder shows a shortened on-time command; official Basilisk thruster and fuel-tank recorders confirm nonzero thrust and reduced propellant use, with paired A/B comparing the final orbital response.
